description_en: Restarts specified instances of a service
description_zh: 调用DeleteServiceInstances重启服务的指定实例
kebab_example: aliyun eas delete-service-instances --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteServiceInstances

parameters.help_en: The region where the service is located
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the service. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The instances to restart. Separate multiple instance names with a comma (,). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412108.html
parameters.help_zh: 重启的实例列表，多个实例名称之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。如何查看实例名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412108.html
parameters.name: instance_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to restart only the container process without rebuilding the instance. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否只重启容器进程，不重建实例。默认为false
parameters.name: soft_restart

parameters.help_en: The name of the container in which to restart the process. This parameter is valid only when \`SoftRestart\` is set to \`true\`
parameters.help_zh: 需要重启进程的容器名称。只有在SoftRestart参数为true，该参数才会生效
parameters.name: container

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the instance is a replica
parameters.help_zh: 当前实例是否为实例单元
parameters.name: is_replica

Message.example: Instance(s) [foo-rdsb,foo-rdsa]  for service [foo] in region [cn-shanghai] was deleted successfully
